# Steven X. Han

> Steven X. Han is a solutions architect based in Melbourne, Australia, working across data, cloud and cyber security. He is also an NFP board member, a volunteer first responder, a dog dad and a runner. This is his personal site at https://stevenhan.net - a single page with a short introduction and links to a few small web tools he has built.

Steven's tagline: "Here to learn about all the wonderful things in life."

## About

- Role: Solutions Architect (data, cloud, cyber security)
- Location: Melbourne, Australia
- Also: NFP board member, volunteer first responder, dog dad, runner

## Selected experiments

Small web tools Steven has built for the fun of it:

- [AirGap Express](https://airgap-express.vercel.app/): Transfer files across devices with no network connection.
- [Keymaker](https://keymaker-iota.vercel.app/): Check whether your private key has been compromised.
- [The Urinal Algorithm](https://urinal-algorithm.vercel.app/): Simulate the optimal urinal selection.
- [Where Is My Train](https://where-is-my-train.stevenhan.net/): Live train tracking for Melbourne's rail network.
